```{=html}
<script>
  // Allows linking straight to a tab, e.g. outputs.html#deep-dives
  function activateTabFromHash() {
    const map = {
      "expeditions": "Expeditions",
      "live-sprints": "Live Sprints",
      "deep-dives": "Deep Dives",
      "masterpiece": "Masterpiece"
    };
    const label = map[window.location.hash.replace("#", "").toLowerCase()];
    if (!label) return;
    document.querySelectorAll(".nav-tabs .nav-link").forEach(function (link) {
      if (link.textContent.trim() === label) link.click();
    });
  }
  window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", activateTabFromHash);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", activateTabFromHash);
</script>
```
